description: Shadow anomaly engine configuration. EXPERIMENTAL — this file tunes what the engine calls exceptional. It never enables notifications: alerts.enabled is honoured by nothing in Phase 5, and the engine contains no notification code path at all.
storeBelowThresholdNote: Sub-threshold decisions are stored too (status 'below-threshold') so false NEGATIVES can be inspected during evaluation, not just false positives. Only >= threshold rows are 'candidate'.

baseline.relaxationNote: Origin, destination, cabin and trip type are NEVER relaxed — economy is not comparable with business, and one-way is not comparable with return. Only the softer dimensions are dropped, in this order, when the strict sample is too thin.

seasonality.note: Phase 5 preserves travelMonth / departureWeekday / tripLength / daysUntilDeparture in every candidate's feature set but does NOT partition baselines by them yet. Christmas Bangkok and September Bangkok currently share a baseline; the features are stored so a later phase can split them retroactively.

cpp.weakCashNote: With no usable cash comparable the CPP component is dropped and the remaining award weights are renormalised — scoring it zero would punish an award for a gap in OUR data. A weak comparable still yields a CPP number but caps the CPP component and adds WEAK_CASH_COMPARATOR.

presets.note: CONFIG ONLY — Phase 5 records which preset a candidate WOULD have matched. No alert is produced by any of them. Alerting is a later phase and an explicit decision.

alerts.note: Hard-off for Phase 5. There is no notification transport in this codebase — no Telegram, no ntfy, no push, no email. Setting this true does nothing today; enabling alerts is a deliberate future change reviewed on its own.
